## ConfigValidationError class

Thrown when a config value fails structural or semantic validation. Mirrors the pure-TypeScript `vaultkeeper` library's `ConfigValidationError`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class ConfigValidationError extends VaultError 
```
**Extends:** [VaultError](./wasm.vaulterror.md)
